signOrder.description: 1-based position in the signing order. Signers with equal values sign as a group, in any order within it; the next group starts when the whole group has signed. Must be 1 or greater. Defaults to 1. Only enforced as an order when sequentialSigning is true.

AgreementCopy.description: An immutable agreement copy. `content` is the exact text; its SHA-256 is `contentSha256`.

signaturePlacements.description: Optional. Omit to let bb-sign place signatures automatically.

signOrder.description: 1-based position in the signing order. Signers with equal values sign as a group, in any order within it; the next group starts when the whole group has signed. Must be 1 or greater. Defaults to 1. Only enforced as an order when sequentialSigning is true.

DocumentFile.description: One stored file of a document: whether it can be downloaded now, and its retention dates (#214).

archivesAt.description: From this date the file may be in archive storage. Null when it never archives, and null until archiving is enabled.

availability.description: `AVAILABLE` and `RESTORED` can be downloaded. `ARCHIVED` needs a restore; `RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS` is being restored; `DELETED` is past its 365 days. Further values may be added.

availableUntil.description: When a `RESTORED` copy stops being readable.

deletesAt.description: No longer available from this date; erased permanently within the following days.

restorable.description: True when the file is `ARCHIVED` and the caller may download it, so a restore can be requested.

signaturePlacements.description: Your own signature placements on this document; empty when the signature is placed automatically. Returned before any OTP, like the documents themselves.

kind.description: Which file of the document to restore.

DocumentRestoreResponse.description: 202: the files being restored, under one `requestId`. 200: nothing needed restoring, and `availability` says why.

availability.description: 200 only: the file can be downloaded now.

availableUntil.description: 200 with `RESTORED`: when the restored copy stops being readable.

requestId.description: 202 only: identifies this request; one email per person and request.

alreadyInProgress.description: True when someone else's restore of this file was already running; this request joined it.

restoresInProgress.description: Restores of this envelope's files that are running. Present on `getEnvelope` only; null in `listEnvelopes`.

stampWarnings.description: Signers whose signature mark could not be rendered on the signed documents, so a placeholder was stamped instead; their signature and its evidence are recorded. Present on `getEnvelope` only (null in `listEnvelopes`), empty when there are none, and null for an archived envelope.

EnvelopeRetention.description: When an envelope's files archive and stop being available (#214). Fixed 365-day retention: dates are rounded up to 00:00 UTC and are the earliest any file of the envelope reaches; the per-file dates on `listEnvelopeDocuments` are exact.

archivesAt.description: From this date the envelope's files may be in archive storage and need a restore before download. Null when they never archive (the envelope is not completed), and null until archiving is enabled.

deletesAt.description: No longer available from this date; the files are erased permanently within the following days.

EnvelopeStampFailure.description: Why the worker could not produce an envelope's signed documents (#298). Contact support: the documents are produced once it is resolved, without new signatures.

attempts.description: How many stamping attempts failed for this reason.

code.description: `SIGNATURE_IMAGE_UNSAFE`: a stored signature image is too large to process. Further values may be added.

detail.description: A short reason label, for example `dimensions` or `bytes`. Never image data.

failedAt.description: When stamping first failed for this reason.

signerId.description: The signer whose signature image stopped the stamp.

EnvelopeStampWarning.description: A signer whose signature mark could not be rendered, so the signed documents show a placeholder instead (#298). The signature itself and its evidence are recorded.

code.description: `SIGNATURE_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER`: the stored signature image could not be decoded. Further values may be added.

detail.description: A short reason label, for example `format` or `decode`. Never image data.

signerName.description: The signer's name, while the signer is on the envelope.

RestoreInProgressResponse.description: Restores of this envelope's files that are running. Present on `getEnvelope` only; null in `listEnvelopes`.

signatureImage.description: The signature as a PNG data URL: exactly `data:image/png;base64,` followed by strict base64. The PNG must be at most 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes), at most 8192 x 4096 pixels and 20,000,000 pixels in total, 8 bits per sample, colour type 0, 2, 3, 4 or 6, not interlaced and not animated (no `acTL`/`fcTL`/`fdAT`), with no compressed text chunks (`zTXt`, `iTXt`) and ancillary chunks of at most 16 KiB each and 64 KiB in total; its image data must inflate to exactly the size its header declares. A canvas `toDataURL('image/png')` export meets this. The whole request body is limited to 1.5 MiB (1,572,864 bytes). Refusals, each leaving the link unused: 400 `SIGNATURE_IMAGE_INVALID` (not such a PNG); 400 `SIGNATURE_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE` (over the byte or pixel limits); 413 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (the body is over its limit); 408 `SIGNATURE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT` (the body arrived too slowly; retry); 429 `RATE_LIMITED` (too many attempts from this client or on this link; retry after `Retry-After`); 503 `SIGNING_BUSY` (retry after `Retry-After`, about one second).

signatureMethod.description: Optional. How the signature mark was made, as declared by the client: `DRAWN` (drawn on screen), `TYPED` (the signer's name typed on screen) or `UPLOADED_IMAGE` (an image of a handwritten signature from the device). The server does not check it against the image; the evidence certificate prints it as the client's declaration, and as not recorded when it is omitted. Any other value is refused with 400 `SIGNATURE_METHOD_INVALID` and leaves the link unused.

SignaturePlacementSpec.description: Where one signer's signature is drawn on one document. For each document, give a placement for every signer or for none. A `{{signerN}}` text marker in the PDF, where N is the signer's `signOrder`, takes precedence over the placement when the document is stamped.

height.description: Height as a fraction (0–1) of the displayed page height. Must stay within the page.

page.description: 0-based page index. If the page does not exist, this placement is ignored when stamping and the signature is placed automatically.

signerIndex.description: 0-based index into this request's `signers` array, in the order sent: the first signer is 0. It is not the signer's `signOrder`, and not a signer id.

width.description: Width as a fraction (0–1) of the displayed page width. Must stay within the page. A rectangle smaller than 48×18 in the page's own user-space units (the units of its MediaBox and CropBox; 1/72 inch when `/UserUnit` is absent) is ignored when stamping, and the signature is placed automatically. `/UserUnit` is ignored.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction (0–1) of the page width as displayed: the crop box clipped to the media box (or the media box when the two do not overlap, as pdf.js does), with the page's rotation applied, origin at its top-left corner.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction (0–1) of the displayed page height, measured downward from the top-left corner.

deletesAt.description: No longer available from this date; erased permanently within the following days.

SignerSignaturePlacement.description: Where YOUR signature will be placed on this document: the signer this link belongs to, never anyone else. Fractions (0–1) of the page as displayed (crop box with the page's rotation applied), origin at its top-left corner; same frame as SignaturePlacementSpec. A `{{signerN}}` marker in the PDF, a page that does not exist, or a rectangle under 48×18 points means the signature is placed automatically instead.

height.description: Height, fraction of the displayed page height.

width.description: Width, fraction of the displayed page width.

x.description: Left edge, fraction of the displayed page width.

y.description: Top edge, fraction of the displayed page height, measured downward.

WebhookEvent.description: The body of a webhook delivery. Signed per RFC-style HMAC; see docs/api/webhook-signature-spec.md.

type.description: One of eight values today; further event types may be added, and a receiver must ignore one it does not know. Asserted against DispatchableEvent.PUBLIC_NAMES.

WebhookEventData.description: Per-type payload. `envelope` is always present; `signer` only for signer.* events; `document` only for document.restored.

evidenceStatus.description: The evidence certificate when this notice was sent: `ISSUED` (it is in `evidenceCertificate`), `PENDING` (it will follow as `envelope.evidence_issued`), `FAILED` (it could not be produced), or `UNAVAILABLE` (this envelope will never have one). Further values may be added. Present on `envelope.completed` and `envelope.evidence_issued` only.

signedDocumentsStatus.description: `READY` when every document had its signed copy when this notice was sent. `PREPARING`: treat `documents[].signedSha256` as unknown, and fetch the signed documents later from `documentsPath`. Absent means `READY` on older payloads.

WebhookEventRestoredDocument.description: `document.restored` only: the file whose restore ended.

availableUntil.description: When `RESTORED`: the restored copy stops being readable at this instant.

outcome.description: `RESTORED`: readable until `availableUntil`. `AVAILABLE`: it never needed a restore. `FAILED`: see `reason`. Further values may be added.

reason.description: When `FAILED`: `DELETED` (past its 365 days), `TIMEOUT` (it took too long; ask again) or `STORAGE_ERROR`. Null otherwise.

WebhookEventRetention.description: `envelope.completed` only: the envelope's retention dates, the earliest any of its files reaches. Absent on every other event type, and on an `envelope.completed` sent before this field existed.

archivesAt.description: From this date the envelope's files may be in archive storage and need a restore before download. Null while archiving is not enabled.

deletesAt.description: No longer available from this date; the files are erased permanently within the following days.

authMethod.description: How the signer was identified when they signed: `EMAIL_LINK` (the signing link only) or `EMAIL_LINK_OTP` (the link plus a one-time code sent by email). More values may be added. Null until the signer signs, and for signatures made before this field existed.

clientCredentials.description: Client-credentials grant. The `bb_sign_org_id` claim is projected onto the token by an `oidc-usermodel-attribute-mapper` on the service-account user, so a machine identity is scoped exactly as a human one is.

info.description:
The endpoints a customer organisation can call directly, plus the public signing
and verification endpoints a signer's browser uses.

Organisation-scoped operations authenticate with an OAuth2 client-credentials
token carrying the `org_api` role. Credentials are issued self-service from the
settings panel; the token's `bb_sign_org_id` claim scopes every request, and
there is no request shape that names a different organisation.

The signing ceremony and verification endpoints are deliberately unauthenticated
— a signer is a member of the public holding a link — and are marked with an
empty `security` array.

post.description: From day 90 a document's signed file, and the original of a completed envelope, may be in archive storage (`availability: ARCHIVED` on `listEnvelopeDocuments`) and cannot be downloaded until restored. This asks for one file to be restored. Only one restore of a file runs, however many people ask: a second request joins it (`alreadyInProgress: true`). Answers **202** while it is being restored, usually a few hours; the people who asked get an email, and integrations get the `document.restored` webhook (subscribe to it: an API credential is never emailed). The restored copy can then be downloaded from `listEnvelopeDocuments` for 7 days. Answers **200** when the file needs no restore. Requires `document:download`. Refused with 409 `DOCUMENT_NOT_SIGNED`, 410 `DOCUMENT_DELETED` (past its 365 days), 429 `RESTORE_LIMIT_REACHED` (too many restores running for the organization) and 503 `ARCHIVAL_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` (retry later).
